summary: Iter 78 — Phase 2 Store & Inventory (Procurement / Accounts / Finance integration) fully tested. Backend: 15/15 HTTP API tests + 4/4 unit tests pass (1 skip for OpenAPI GRNIn schema absent in registry, 1 skip because no non-approved PO available to trigger manual_grn 403 branch in live DB — both covered by unit test that asserts the model fields & branch source). All 7 /api/inv2/* GET endpoints return 200 with correct shape; pr-from-stock create+persistence works (PR-202606-NNNNN format, status=submitted, source=stock_shortage, found in /api/procurement/prs); priority whitelist enforced (400 on INVALID_X, 400 on qty<=0, 404 on missing item); GRNIn extended with 11 Phase 2 fields all backward-compatible; three_way_match boolean correctly derived from bill presence + amount diff <1. Frontend: login OK, all 7 Phase 2 nav testids render in sidebar across 3 new groups (Procurement / Accounts / Finance Integration), each view renders real data without React errors. Pipeline tile shows PR=2, PO=1 ₹9,000, GRN30d=3, Emergency=0. Pending POs view shows PO-2026-0044 with line-level ordered=100/received=0/pending=100/pending_value=₹9,000 — math correct. PRFromStock form has prfs-select-all + prfs-priority + prfs-submit testids. All 3 CSV export buttons (pending-pos-csv, grn-pending-inv-csv, inward-csv) present. Phase 1 regression intact (si-nav-dashboard still present, /app/purchase-requisitions, /app/grn still load). No console JS errors on Phase 2 views (401 errors observed pre-auth on a non-Phase-2 polling endpoint — unrelated).
action_items: (optional, low) Add a non-approved PO in seed data so the manual_grn=true → 403 (PM) and 200 (admin) override branch can be covered by HTTP tests in addition to the existing unit-source assertion.
(optional, low) /api/inv2/inspection-hold returns total_held_value computed as sum(hold_qty * 0) — always 0; either remove the field or multiply by the line rate.
(optional) Add GRNIn schema to OpenAPI components (currently omitted), so SDET tools can introspect Phase 2 fields without code inspection.
(optional) PR auto-numbering uses count_documents — already flagged in Iter 77; acceptable for v1 but switch to an atomic counter or unique index before high-concurrency rollouts.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_phase2_router.py L400 `total_held_value` is sum(hold_qty * 0) — always 0; either drop the key or use line rate to get a real held value.

inventory_phase2_router.py L89 PR numbering via count_documents is race-prone under concurrency (two simultaneous calls can produce the same pr_number). Acceptable for v1 but add a unique index on pr_number or migrate to an atomic counters collection.

stock_inward_report L227-229 filter uses raw string comparison on `created_at` ISO strings — works only if the field is consistently stored as ISO-8601 with `Z` suffix; document the contract or convert to datetime on read.

grn_pending_invoice L302 parses `created_at` with .replace('Z','+00:00'); if created_at is missing, falls back to now() — days_pending=0. Consider using grn_date when created_at is null instead of silently defaulting.

pr-from-stock auto-priority logic (L85) only bumps `normal`→`urgent`; it never downgrades when caller already supplied `emergency`. Logic is correct, but worth a code comment so future devs don't think the priority is being overwritten.
